published_by: Office for National Statistics, Annual Survey of Hours and Earnings (ASHE), Table 14
what_this_is: Median gross hourly pay excluding overtime, UK, all employees, for SOC 7211 'Call and contact centre occupations', one revised edition per year fetched. The labour price a supplier's phone desk pays.

basis.soc_break: SOC 2010 to 2019, SOC 2020 from 2022. The two codes for 7211 are not identical populations; the series is not spliced here.
basis.not_fetched: 2017, 2018, 2020, 2021, 2023. A reader interpolating between editions states it (company/crm/contact_centre_staffing.wage_gbp_per_hour does, as a SIMPLIFICATION).

provenance_legend.primary: read from the ONS workbook itself, zip hash recorded

source_check.derived: 2026-11-24, re-fetched from the five zip URLs in `editions`; every zip's sha256 equals the one the knowledge page recorded on 2026-11-21, and every median equals company/crm/contact_centre_staffing.ASHE_CALL_CENTRE_MEDIAN_GBP_PER_HOUR.
source_check.how_to_recheck: GET the dataset page https://www.ons.gov.uk/employmentandlabourmarket/peopleinwork/earningsandworkinghours/datasets/occupation4digitsoc2010ashetable14 and list every <year>(provisional|revised)/...zip link. ONS publishes each year provisional, then revised a year later. A year already held here appearing under a later revision than the one in `editions` means its median may have moved; a new year is outside 2016-2025 and changes nothing held.

checked_for_supersession.note: Asked 2026-11-24 on the dataset page: the latest links are 2025revised and 2026provisional. No year held here has a later revision; 2026 provisional is a new year outside the run's 2016-2025 window.
